BiblicalUsage: Hamul was the younger son of Pharez, Judah's son by Tamar, and his name turns up wherever Judah's line is counted. He went down into Egypt with Jacob's family, his sons became the family of the Hamulites in the wilderness census, and Chronicles counts him among the sons of Pharez.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hamul's quiet place in three censuses is the point: God keeps the line of Judah by name, generation after generation, even for a younger son.
